description: Defines the 'Holiday' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including properties like id, name, date, length, recurring status, and operational country, with ORM mappings and constants for holiday types.

classes.name: Holiday
classes.description: Entity class representing a holiday with properties, constants for holiday types, and ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the holiday.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the holiday.

methods.name: isRecurring
methods.description: Checks if the holiday is recurring.

methods.name: setRecurring
methods.description: Sets the recurring status of the holiday.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name/description of the holiday.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name/description of the holiday.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the holiday.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the holiday.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the holiday (full day or half day).

methods.name: setLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the holiday.

methods.name: getOperationalCountry
methods.description: Returns the operational country associated with the holiday.

methods.name: setOperationalCountry
methods.description: Sets the operational country for the holiday.
